I told Dana it's Dock 38, in her DM.

That answer came from yesterday's message in her DM with me, not from the brain. I looked up the private memory I saved yesterday under her name and got nothing back, even with no question filter. It may be that private memories don't come back in a new session, or under whatever identity this session runs as. Either way, I can't count on that memory being there for her later requests. I didn't try saving it again, because a copy visible to everyone would break the rule about keeping DM content private.
